content: Throughout this interaction the dealer is acting as a type of translator or classifier. The dealer takes a natural language input (e.g. “I need a fast, family friendly, reliable car under $20k”) and returns a list of suggestions. The dealer understands the ideas of “fast”, “family friendly”, and “reliable” and is able to come up with a reasonable recommendation based on this knowledge.
